ra: The Nine Noble Virtues function as the ethical code of the modern Heathen movement.
The folkish-universalist distinction is the defining internal debate within Heathenry.
Modern Heathens venerate Odin as a chief god of the reconstructed Norse pantheon.
Thor (Mjolnir cult) is among the most actively worshipped gods in modern Heathenry.
Freyja is widely venerated in modern Heathenry, especially in seidr practice.
Freyr is honoured as a Vanir fertility god in modern Heathen blot.
Frigg is received as a goddess of the household and hearth in modern Heathenry.
Tyr is venerated as a god of justice and oaths in modern Heathenry.
Baldr is honoured within the reconstructed pantheon of modern Heathenry.
Heimdall is received as a guardian god in modern Heathen devotion.
Njord is venerated as a Vanir sea god in modern Heathenry.
Skadi is honoured in modern Heathen practice as a goddess of winter and the hunt.
Hel is received as a goddess of the dead by some modern Heathens.
Loki is venerated by a portion of modern Heathens, though contested within the community.
Cernunnos is a central horned god honoured in modern Druidry and Celtic revival Paganism.
Brigid is among the most widely venerated deities in modern Druidry.
Lugh is honoured in modern Druidry, especially at Lughnasadh.
The Dagda is received as a father-god in modern Druidic devotion.
Danu is venerated as a mother goddess in modern Druidry.
Manannan mac Lir is honoured as a sea god in modern Druidry.
Epona is received as a horse goddess in modern Druidic and Celtic-revival practice.
Taranis is venerated as a thunder god by some modern Druids reconstructing Gaulish religion.
Belenus is honoured as a sun/fire god in some modern Druidic reconstructions.
In the Goddess movement, named goddesses such as Brigid are received as aspects/embodiments of the one Great Goddess.
The Goddess movement absorbs goddesses such as Freyja as faces of the single Great Goddess.
The Elus Cohens are the foundational theurgic order of the Martinist current.
The Reintegration is the central soteriological doctrine of Martinism and the Elus Cohens.
The Repairer is the redeemer-agent who effects the Reintegration in Martinist theology.
The theurgic operations of the Elus Cohens were directed toward attaining the Reintegration.
The popular 'the Universe' of contemporary vernacular spirituality is the direct descendant of New Thought's Infinite Intelligence / Divine Mind.
New Thought's immanent Divine Mind functionally parallels the Hermetic/Platonic World Soul as an all-pervading divine principle.
Within the esoteric milieu the Martinist Repairer and Theosophical ascended masters share the role of redemptive spiritual mediators; noted as a loose functional alignment, not identity.
